Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Only the starship making a move causes Force loss (e.g. [[Home One]] moving away with X-wings embarked aboard loses 1 Force, not multiple).
* Force loss is based on an opponent's starship moving from [[Fulminatrix]]'s location to any other location. Can be caused by using hyperspeed, landing, moving to a sector, moving to/from a [[Death Star]], etc., not by embarking/disembarking.
